minecraftFeatures.description: Whether to enable Minecraft-specific features for Geary like event bridging. Requires item and entity tracking to be enabled.

actions.description: Whether to enable Geary actions (ex. used for item configs.)

removeVanillaMobTypes.description: List of mob types to remove if they are not entities with Geary prefabs (i.e. vanilla entities)

spawning.description: Whether to enable Geary's spawning system

trackPlayers.description: Whether players should be tracked as entities in Geary

trackOtherEntities.description: Whether all other Minecraft entities should be tracked as entities in Geary

migrateByCustomModelData.description: If an item has no prefabs encoded, try to find its prefab by matching custom model data.

defaultUnlockedSlots.description: How many of the 9 passive slots new players start with unlocked

menuTitle.description: Title of the passive slots menu opened from the recipe book button

anyOf.description: Item shown in locked slots, remove to leave them empty, they reject items either way
minecraft:<material> for a vanilla item, anything else is a prefab

prefabs.description: Whether to load prefab files located in the Geary plugin folder.

recipes.description: Whether to register recipes defined in Geary prefabs

asyncWrite.description: Whether to throw an error when an entity write operation occurs outside of the server thread.

asyncEntityConversion.description: Whether to throw an error when converting bukkit concepts to geary entities outside of the server thread.

outputPath.description:
The path to generate the pack to from `plugins/Geary`
Adding .zip to path will export as a zip instead of directory

includedPackPath.description: Points to a resourcepack in zip or directory format to merge into Geary's pack

mainTitle.description: Emojy title of the main menu, the sections open below it

gridTitle.description: Emojy title of a section grid, 8 columns wide with the buttons in the right column

searchTitle.description: Emojy title of the search dialog

scrollMode.description: SCROLLING moves one row at a time, PAGINATED swaps the whole grid

textures.description: Textures the generated resourcepack puts on the grid buttons

anyOf.description: The material used for this item, optionally using the full namespace (minecraft:<item>) or just <item>
The potion and custom effects contained in this potion, splash potion, lingering potion, or tipped arrow.
The recipes that a player unlocks when this knowledge book is used.
The sherds applied on each face of this decorated pot. If the list has less than 4 entries, the remaining ones default to "minecraft:brick"

com.mineinabyss.ResolvableSerializer.description: A number, or the key of a context provider that resolves to one
com.mineinabyss.ResolvableSerializer.title: Resolvable

com.mineinabyss.ResolvableDurationSerial.description: A duration, a plain number of ticks, or the key of a context provider that resolves to ticks
com.mineinabyss.ResolvableDurationSerial.title: Resolvable duration
